item.title: 'No good time for you': The recordkeeping snafu keeping some Illinoisans in prison longer than they should be

item.title: What to know about Illinois gun rights around federal immigration agents
item.description: <p>After federal immigration agents killed Veteran Affairs intensive care nurse Alex Pretti in Minneapolis last month, President Donald Trump and senior administration officials blamed Pretti’s death on his possession of a firearm.</p><p>“Certainly he shouldn’t have been carrying a gun,” Trump told reporters days after Pretti was fatally shot as he filmed immigration agents with his cellphone camera. Videos showed Pretti never reached for his gun, and agents disarmed him before opening fire.</p>
